title: Funnel curtain (Springs lead-funnel / callback CTA reveal)
source: springs.estate l-callback funnel / /flats hub (most-linked node, 9 links = funnel hub) — the conversion beat. Engine = library/components/funnel-curtain (proven, imperative play(swapFn, mode), owns_pin:false, no narrow-guard). NO engine patch needed.
engine: The black wordmark curtain ritual (T-M29): a black panel rides bottom→up with a spaced wordmark on its top edge, covers, swaps the page UNDER full coverage, then rides out (~2.25s). mode:'flash' = the T-530 short black blink between visual-search drill levels (no wordmark, ~0.45s). Imperative: create(opts) → play(swapFn, mode).
differs: Same curtain mechanic + same play(swapFn, mode) drive the SAME translateY panel on both platforms. This is the INTERACTION-DRIVEN subtype (teardown: trigger = programmatic play() on a CTA TAP, NOT scroll — RECIPE trigger; and mobile-is-pinned-scroll exception list: a conversion CTA is a tap beat, not a scroll-pin). The LAYOUT + preset differ, not the driver source: desktop is the wide 2-col funnel hub (SEARCH FLATS / AVAILABLE SOON + lead-form) and can use mode:'flash' for the drill; mobile is the single-col full-bleed funnel — same tap, same curtain over the whole phone. reduced-motion → the core swaps immediately, zero curtain.

desktop.driver: tapFunnel('curtain') — CTA click drives the full brand ritual (rise → billboard pause → cover → swap-under-coverage → exit). drill 'back' uses mode:'flash'.

mobile.driver: tapFunnel('curtain') — SAME CTA tap drives the SAME play(swapFn); single-col full-bleed layout so the ritual reads over the whole phone.

wordmark.what: the spaced edge-row string that rides on the panel top edge.

repeat.what: how many times the wordmark repeats across the edge (live footage: one giant pass).

pauseMs.what: the brand-billboard pause at pauseAt coverage (the read-window).

pauseAt.what: coverage fraction where the panel holds as a billboard.

mode.what: 'curtain' = full ~2.25s ritual; 'flash' = ~0.45s black blink (T-530 drill), no wordmark.

engine_patch: NONE — imperative engine (create → play), no scroll driver, no narrow-guard, owns_pin:false. Nothing to bypass; same posture as portrait-carousel. The wrapper only wires [data-fc-cta] buttons to play() and crossfades .fc-page panels under coverage.
entry: FunnelCurtainDual.init(target, opts) -> { platform, engine, driver }. Load engine.js THEN component.js. Markup: .fc-stage > .fc-page(.is-on) with [data-fc-cta data-fc-swap='<sel>' data-fc-mode='curtain|flash'] buttons; the wrapper crossfades .fc-page.is-on on swap.
law: transform (translateY of the panel; the edge letters ride WITH the panel — zero separate tweens) only; GPU; swapFn fires EXACTLY under full coverage (viewer never sees the swap); the panel is removed from the DOM after the ritual; parallel play() ignored (one curtain at a time); NO WebGL. reduced-motion → swapFn immediately, no panel.
